Let me understand the system flow:
1. Source fetcher (kulturhuset.ts) - fetches events from Elasticsearch
2. sourceRunner.ts - calls the fetcher and queues events
3. queue.ts - manages the raw_events queue
4. normalizer.ts - processes raw events, creates venues and events in Supabase
5. App.js - frontend that queries Supabase

Now let me check the index.ts to see how the system is started, and the App.js to see how frontend queries data.
